t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes appear in pairs - Orange , blue , green and red lead you to bright forests and brown ,yellow,pink, purple lead you to darker forest , goal is to focus on the colours of the gnomes and not their physical features or actions . The number of mushrooms changes each forest , gnomes always appear in fixed pairs but their stances may vary , keep track of the mushrooms you can forage in each forest / Sucess of the game will depend on paying attention to colours .

vb_textbox.text: Hello, This advice differs from the advice I was told which was to go for the orange , blue , red , green and blue gnomes. The gnomes always come in pairs of two and you will notice that their pairs do not change however I found that going into the darker forest gave me more points than going into the lighter forest which was the orignal advice I trusted to play the game but when I found it more rewarding to go into the darker forest I continued using that. The darker forest gnome colours- Brown, Pink, yellow and purple Lighter Forest - Orange , blue , green and red gnomes.The amount of mushrooms change each time you go into the forest but you need to pay attention to the amount of mushrooms given say if the lighter forest only gave you a few mushrooms you may want to try going into the darker forest to try get more points as the more points you rack up the better your bonus will be.I hope this advice treats you well and good luckProlific particpant C
